reader.requirement: At --std 85, every literal in ADD formats 1 and 2 (literal-1 before TO, literal-2 after TO or as the last addend when TO is omitted) must be a numeric literal or, by §1985:IV figurative-constant exception (1), the figurative constant ZERO (ALL being redundant there); nonnumeric literals and every other figurative constant, including ALL literal and a symbolic character, are refused, as are post-1985 literal forms (hexadecimal, floating-point, more than 18 digits).

edition-consulted.switches: ALL ZERO as an arithmetic operand: admitted at 1985 (ALL redundant), COBOL0902 from 2002
numeric literal digit cap: 18 at 1985, 31 from 2002

reader.edition-search: read NonNumericInNumericContext (the one nonnumeric-literal to numeric-context reading, no edition test except ZeroOperand's ALL gate); grep Constructs in LiteralScreen.cs for the literal-form gates
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: ALL ZERO is admitted at 1985 and refused from 2002; literal forms added later (hexadecimal, floating-point, 19 to 31 digits) are refused at 1985; the refusal of nonnumeric literals and non-ZERO figuratives is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one nonnumeric literal in format 1; not exercised: figurative constants other than ZERO, ALL literal, a symbolic character, literal-2 of format 2, the admitted ZERO/ALL ZERO forms, signed and decimal literals, the 18-digit edge and later literal forms

probes.printed: error COBOL0844 at each of the 11 statements: "123", SPACE, HIGH-VALUE, QUOTE, LOW-VALUES, ALL "1", symbolic SYMA, format 2 addend "2", format 2 literal-2 "2" after TO, SPACES, ALL "3" after TO
probes.expected: each is not a numeric literal and not ZERO: refused

signed/decimal literals sum to 3.25; ZERO forms and ALL ZERO add 0; format 2 with literal-2 ZERO and .25 into an edited receiver; 18-digit literal accepted; overflow takes SIZE ERROR and leaves M unchanged

probes.printed: COBOL0900 hexadecimal literal requires COBOL-2002 (plus COBOL0844); COBOL0900 floating-point literal requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0802 19-digit literal (and COBOL0805 composite > 18)

reader.notes: Every ADD literal position goes through ExpressionBinder's one numeric-context literal reading, which admits a numeric literal or ZERO and refuses every other nonnumeric or figurative form with COBOL0844 in both formats. ZERO's admission rests on §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1 ("the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO"). Diagnostics at --std 85 cite §2023 clauses, which is cosmetic.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-159/add1.cob at --std 85 under DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (runs/add1-001): 'ADD 1,5' 1,50; 'ADD 1, 2' (comma-space separator) 4,50; ',25 -0,75 +1' 5,00; format 2 with TO omitted 'ADD ZEROES ALL ZEROS 2 GIVING Y' 2,00; 18-digit fraction ',000000000000000001' added; leading-zero 18-digit literal 000000000000000003 plus 0002 = 5,00 -- all as the 1985 literal rules give. Refusals: a 19-digit literal written with leading zeros COBOL0802 (+COBOL0805) (add-bad1); 'ALL 0' (ALL with a numeric literal) COBOL5506 (add-bad2); '1.5' under DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA COBOL0895 (add-bad3); ALL ZERO as a GIVING receiver COBOL5506 (add-bad4/5). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.6.3 SR2 'Each literal must be a numeric literal'; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1 'the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO'; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GR6 'The literal must be a nonnumeric literal' (ALL literal). Format 2's TO is not underlined in the 1985 format, so TO-omitted is a 1985 form and correctly admitted.
